file.content: Todos

lines: .filters button { background: transparent; color: #1c1917; border: 1px solid #d6d3d1; padding: 0.35rem 0.75rem; }
+  .bulk button { background: transparent; color: #1c1917; border: 1px solid #d6d3d1; padding: 0.35rem 0.75rem; }
+  // [REQ-009] Mutates in place; orderedTodos re-derives grouping and priority order, and the array keeps insertion order.

content.text:
I added two buttons under the filters: `bulk-mark-all` marks every todo complete, and `bulk-clear-completed` deletes all completed todos. I haven't run the page in a browser to check them.

They keep the agreed order. Both buttons only change the todos' state and don't re-sort anything. The list is sorted each time it's drawn: completed todos below active ones (DEC-003), then high, med, low within each group, with ties kept in the order they were added (DEC-009, DEC-010).

Both buttons act on every todo, not just the ones the current filter or search is showing.
